name: Suspense Build
description: Declarative preset for withheld information and rising dread. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Delay the known outcome just long enough for the reader to feel the gap.
writing_goals: Give the reader a question they can hold
Advance the clock or constraint each beat
Plant a fair clue before the turn
Pay off tension with a change, not a fake-out reset
constraints: Do not withhold information the POV character already has without a stated reason
Do not invent last-second facts the text never prepared
Do not imitate a living thriller author's signature devices
checklist: A time, resource, or social clock is ticking
At least one fair clue is present
The release changes knowledge or danger
